title: Basis of the Arrears Settlement Figure on a Crop Input Purchasing Account
content:
**1. The product balance.** The product balance the figure is built on is everything invoiced to the account that has run past the programme's terms, which is every delivery invoiced to it apart from those invoiced within the statement months the programme's terms cover, the programme's terms in days being taken over a statement month of 30 days, less every payment posted to the account, every credit memo written on it and every discount granted on it.

**2. Service charges carried in.** The share of the service charges standing on the account that is carried into the settlement figure is nil.

**3. The settlement base.** The settlement base is the product balance plus the share carried in of the service charges standing on the account, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places.

**4. The share the member must remit.** The share of the settlement base the member must remit is the reinstatement share the programme carries.

**5. The age step.** The further share of the settlement base added for the age of the arrears is nil.

**6. The amount sought.** The amount sought is the settlement base multiplied by the share the member must remit and the further share added for the age of the arrears taken together as one total share, applied once to the settlement base and rounded half away from zero to two decimal places; the two shares are combined before they are applied and they do not act one after the other.

**7. The grain credit.** The share of the value of the grain still owed to the cooperative that is set against the amount sought is nil. The grain credit is the bushels still owed to the cooperative on the member's live grain marketing contract multiplied by the cash price that contract carries and then by the share set against the amount sought, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places.

**8. The patronage credit.** The share of the cash portion of the member's patronage allocation that is set against the amount sought is nil. The patronage credit is the cash portion of the allocations posted to the member's equity account over the twelve statement months before the handling date multiplied by the share set against the amount sought, rounded half away from zero to two decimal places.

**9. The net figure.** The net figure is the amount sought less the grain credit and less the patronage credit, both taken off the amount sought itself and neither taken off the other, and where that net figure is negative it is nil.

**10. The figure quoted.** The figure the member is asked to remit is the net figure as worked out, to the cent. The figure quoted and paid is that figure rounded half away from zero to two decimal places.

## Worked through on hypothetical figures

A member on a programme of the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts carrying terms of 30 calendar days and a reinstatement share of 100 percent. Terms of 30 days taken over a statement month of 30 days cover 1 statement month.

| Step | Figure |
| --- | --- |
| Everything invoiced to the account | 60000.00 USD |
| Invoiced within the 1 statement month the terms cover | 18000.00 USD |
| Invoiced and run past the terms | 42000.00 USD |
| Less payments posted | 9000.00 USD |
| Less credit memos written | 1200.00 USD |
| Less discounts granted | 500.00 USD |
| Product balance | 31300.00 USD |
| Service charges standing on the account | 640.00 USD |
| Share of them carried in | nil |
| Settlement base | 31300.00 USD |
| Share the member must remit | 100 percent |
| Further share for the age of the arrears | nil |
| The two taken together as one total share | 100 percent |
| Amount sought | 31300.00 USD |
| Share of the value of the grain still owed set against it | nil |
| Grain credit | 0.00 USD |
| Share of the cash portion of the patronage allocation set against it | nil |
| Patronage credit | 0.00 USD |
| Net figure | 31300.00 USD |
| Figure quoted and paid | 31300.00 USD |
